name: Community Waves (Transition Network)
description: A free, ethical social platform hosted by Transition Network International for community workers, activists, and volunteers doing community-led change — hundreds of members, by its own count. It's organized into themed and regional spaces (Food, Energy, Cultural Transition, Communicating Transition, and more), most open to all, where members ask questions, swap ideas, and support each other. It also has a members map and a shared calendar where local Transition groups post their events. Members agree to a community agreement on joining.
